module.purpose: Defines a reusable React component that emits browser speculation rules for hover-triggered prefetching and prerendering.
module.summary: This module prepares a speculation rules object from optional prefetch and prerender path lists, assigning moderate eagerness to both behaviors. It serializes the configuration as JSON and injects it through Next.js Script using the browser's speculationrules script type. Empty arrays are used when callers omit either path list.
module.businessContext: Improves perceived navigation speed in the web application by allowing browsers to prefetch or prerender likely destinations. Failure removes these performance optimizations but does not block normal navigation.
functions: SpeculationRules (~L3-34): Builds and injects browser speculation rules for hover navigation paths
systemCapabilities: Inject speculation rules into document markup

io: Emits a Next.js Script element containing serialized speculation rules.

sectionMap.name: component-inputs

edgeCases.behavior: Destructuring defaults each omitted list to an empty array.

edgeCases.inputShape: Empty prefetch or prerender path arrays
edgeCases.behavior: Emits the corresponding speculation rule with an empty urls array.

edgeCases.inputShape: Malformed or non-string path values supplied at runtime
edgeCases.behavior: The function performs no validation before JSON serialization.

invariants.description: Both prefetch and prerender rule entries always use moderate eagerness.
The emitted script always has the speculation-rules type and speculation-rules identifier.
The script payload is valid JSON serialization of the constructed rules object.

assumptions.description: Callers provide path arrays containing values appropriate for browser speculation rules.
The consuming browser and framework support the speculationrules script type.

ambiguities.question: Does the application expect paths to be absolute URLs, route-relative paths, or both?
ambiguities.affects: speculation rule input validation and browser compatibility

concurrencyModel.notes: The component synchronously constructs and serializes a new rules object on each invocation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The component is rendered without path props.
moduleContractTests.then: the element has id="speculation-rules", type="speculationrules", and serialized prefetch and prerender rules with empty urls arrays and eagerness "moderate"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the default browser speculation configuration.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The component receives prefetch and prerender paths.
moduleContractTests.then: the serialized rules contain prefetch.urls ["/about"] and prerender.urls ["/checkout"] with eagerness "moderate"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the mapping from component props to speculation rule URLs.
